name: Hagar's Ordeal
source:
A woman named Hagar wakes up from a coma, unable to remember anything except for her name. Guide her through and help her recover her memories, or let her live her life like normal.

[From [url=https://three-works.itch.io/hagars-ordeal]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位名叫Hagar的女性從昏迷中醒來，除了自己的名字，她什麼都不記得了。引導她恢復記憶，或讓她照常生活，由你決定。

[摘自[url=https://three-works.itch.io/hagars-ordeal]Itch.io[/url]]
